title: Counter-Tune the Fork
prompt: Match the repeating cutter pulse before the cold loop overheats.
success_message: The cutter, suit ground, and operator loop lock into phase.
failure_hint: The signals beat against each other and the cold loop climbs. Adjust the sweep, coolant, and ground phase.

title: Harmonic Choir Lock
prompt: Orion, Gh0st, and Zeke hold the phrase. Place Nova's note where the others leave a breath.
success_message: The Chorus keeps its separate voices and turns with Nova instead of against her.
failure_hint: That beat already carries a voice. Let it finish before Nova joins.

title: Calibrate Bioluminescent Prism
prompt: Aim the beam into the receiver, tighten its fringe, then balance the glow. A steady green receiver means the lattice is ready.
success_message: The crystal lattice locks into a clean green beam, revealing an ancient focus component.
failure_hint: Center the beam, tighten the fringe, and keep the receiver green rather than dim or overloaded.

title: Synchronize Chrono Coils
prompt: Damping and carrier drift pull against each other on the live trace. Flatten the coupled carrier inside the corridor, then line up the return pulse inside the phase gate.
success_message: The tachyon loop locks into phase, expelling an overclocked core.
failure_hint: The coil dropped the signal. Use the readouts to bring each control into range.

title: Conveyor Override
prompt: Use the pulse board and the grease marks to park the belt in a safe position.
failure_hint: The belt is still unsafe. Check the crusher clearance and the stop point.

title: Forge Test Chamber
prompt: Assign a safeguard to each beat of the recorded cycle. The simulation won't move the live machinery.
failure_hint: Review the highlighted beats, then run the test again.

title: Phase-Lock Graviton Well
prompt: Catch the test mass in the receiver ring. The well pulls it sideways, and the brake sets where it stops.
success_message: The receiver catches the mass. Gravity settles around the Graviton Inertia Matrix.
failure_hint: The test mass missed the receiver.
